hooks.command: bash -c 'LAST_MSG=$(git log -1 --pretty=%s 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; echo "$LAST_MSG" | grep -qoE "\[ZEN-[0-9]+\]" && echo "zensu: feature reference detected in commit: $(echo "$LAST_MSG" | grep -oE "\[ZEN-[0-9]+\]" | tr "\n" " ")"'

bash -c 'HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null) || { echo "zensu: not a git repository, pulse session skipped"; exit 0; }; BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$BRANCH" ] && BRANCH="detached"; echo "zensu: pulse session ready — HEAD=$HEAD branch=$BRANCH"'
